test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for Rs. 1,024, there is a loss of 20%. At what price (in Rs.) should it be sold to gain 8%?
solution:
Formula :

CP = SPover 1 -{Lover100} 

Where, L = Loss%

 

Calculation:

According to the question, 

CP = 1024/(1 - 20/100) = 1024 × 5over4 = Rs 1280

New SP = 1280 × (1 + 8/100) = Rs 1382.40

∴ The selling price is Rs 1382.40.
